title: Pick a Model
bottom_line: Describe your job. A Haiku subagent reads Anthropic's guide and recommends a Claude model and effort level. It never runs the job.

sections.heading: Run it with a description of the job

blocks.caption: The description is required. Without one, it asks you for it.

before.label: You type
before.text: a subagent that reads test logs and reports each failing test

after.label: You get
after.text: Haiku 5.5, medium effort, with the guide row it matched

blocks.caption: An example job and the kind of answer you get.

blocks.title: What the reply contains
rows: One of Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 or Fable 5.2.
The starting effort level for that model.
The row of the guide's task table that fits your job.
One line tying your job to that row.
What to try next: let the model check its own work, raise effort one level, then move up a model.

blocks.text: If your job fits no row clearly, you get Opus 5.5 at medium effort, the guide's own answer for "you aren't sure yet".

sections.heading: It uses a stored copy of the guide

cards.title: Recommends only
cards.text: You get a recommendation. Nothing is run or changed.

cards.title: Can be out of date
cards.text: The guide is stored in the plugin. Run `/model-picker:check-guide` to see whether the live guide changed.

next_action.text: Type `/model-picker:pick-model` followed by a sentence describing your job.
next_action.detail: Add what the job does, how big it is and whether a person waits on the reply.
